d: Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD) president Sukhbir Singh Badal announced the renewal of his party's alliance with the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) under the National Democratic Alliance (NDA) framework for the upcoming Punjab Assembly elections. Describing the partnership as an emotional relationship rooted in history rather than merely an electoral adjustment, Badal recalled that the alliance was originally formed under the leadership of his late father Parkash Singh Badal alongside Atal Bihari Vajpayee and L. K. Advani. He stated, 'Akali Dal-BJP alliance is emotional, not just political.' Badal…
